baker_recipe.title: Brown Butter Blondies
baker_recipe.description: Chewy blondies with a walnut crunch and a flaky salt finish.
baker_recipe.story: The batch I bring to potlucks. Brown the butter until it smells like toasted hazelnuts, then don't overbake.
steps: Heat oven to 350°F. Line an 8-inch pan with parchment.
Whisk in brown sugar, then eggs and vanilla.
Fold in flour and salt, then walnuts.
Spread in the pan, scatter flaky salt, bake 26–30 minutes until just set.
